name: Day's 1st Season ~Ashita no Kimi e~
source:
True love adventure!

Six charming characters - choose one and make a happy ending.
Heartpounding flustered passions of the enamoured!

Will you choose:
Tsundere childhood friend...?
Spontaneous class president...?
Exchange student with poor Japanese...?

All six girls have unique individual personalities.
